🚨 PLTR: Earnings Today — Stock Down 33% From Highs, Poised for a 10% Swing

📰 What: Palantir reports Q2 earnings today; Yahoo flags a potential major rebound after a sharp drawdown.

💰 Value: Fwd P/E 60.2, PEG 1.76 — premium justified by +84.7% revenue growth & +325% EPS. Consensus target $182.20 = 44.6% upside. Moat: Deep gov/enterprise lock-in.

📊 Tape:
• 📉 Bearish daily/weekly/monthly; death cross (50<200 EMA), RSI 48 neutral, MACD negative. Volume falling but buyers biased.
• 🎯 Support $122.66 (-2.7%) vs Resistance $137.29 (+8.9%) — R:R 3.35. Price holding exactly at 78.6% fib ($126.17).

🎯 Verdict: Bullish (7/10). Key level: $126.17 fib — hold = bounce to $137+; break below $122.66 risks retest of $106.37. 🫧 AI bubble risk if sentiment shifts — 1.56 beta amplifies.

🚀 NVDA reclaims $2T club vibes — sector peer TSM back at $2T at ~20x fwd earnings, purest AI play stays cheap.

📰 What: TSM milestone confirms AI capex cycle intact (Yahoo). NVDA = top pick to ride it.

💰 Value: EPS +214%, rev +85%, 63% margin. Fwd P/E 16.17x, PEG 0.55 = undervalued. 58-analyst target $302.83 → 45% upside. Moat: CUDA lock-in.

📊 Tape:
• 📈 Weekly/monthly up; 50 EMA > 200 EMA. RSI 54 (neutral), MACD slightly red. Volume flat, buyers biased.
• 🎯 Support $197.32 / Resistance $214.35. R:R to resistance 0.54 — range-bound until breakout.

🎯 Verdict: Bullish 8/10. Key level: $214.35. PEG 0.55 + triple-digit EPS growth = mispriced AI king. 🫧 Bubble risk: high beta 2.21 — a capex pause could compress the multiple fast.

🚀 MSFT’s $175B AI Spend Pays Off — GOOGL Jumps 5% on the Read-Through

📰 Microsoft proved AI capex can drive profits (Yahoo). Positive read-through for Alphabet’s own massive AI outlays.

💰 Value: Forward P/E 25.39, PEG 0.97 (<1) = undervalued. 14.1% upside to $426.95 mean target. Moat: strong (search/cloud/YouTube).

📊 Tape:
• Uptrend: price $374.12 > EMA20/50/200; golden cross (50>200); RSI 61 neutral; MACD positive; volume flat, buyer bias.
• Resistance $374.81 (R:R 0.01) · support $296.72 (-20.7%). 🫧 Stretched short-term, but weekly/monthly uptrends intact.

🎯 Verdict: Bullish 8/10 — key level $374.81; PEG <1 + fortress balance sheet (D/E 18.86, ROE 48.7%) outweigh near-term exhaustion. 🫧 Bubble risk if AI monetization lags capex.

🚀 MSFT +5.26% to $489.17 — Blasts Through Upper Bollinger as AI-Shock Debate Heats Up

📰 What: Yahoo flags MSFT's balance sheet as AI-shock resilient vs Oracle, reinforcing quality bid amid bubble-risk chatter.

💰 Value: Fair — 17.7% rev growth, 31.7% EPS growth, 67.9% GM. Fwd P/E 20.85, PEG 1.52. Analyst target $563.05 = 15.1% upside. Moat: Strong (ecosystem lock-in).

📊 Tape:
• 🔺 Bullish daily/weekly/monthly; RSI 78.48 overbought, price above BB upper ($460.19). Volume flat, buyers.
• ⚖️ Resistance $489.75 (0.12% away) vs support $409.35 — R:R 0.01. Extreme extension, mean-reversion risk.

🎯 Verdict: Neutral (7/10) — $489.75 is the line; chasing offers 0.12% upside vs 16.32% downside. 🫧 AI-spend digestion could compress multiples despite balance-sheet strength.

🚀 AMD Q2 in Focus — AI Data Center Demand Lifts the Whole Semi Complex; AVGO Screens Undervalued at 20x Fwd Earnings

📰 What: AMD’s Q2 topline expected to surge on Data Center demand (EPYC, Instinct, cloud) — read-through bullish for Broadcom’s AI ASICs & networking. (Yahoo)

💰 Value: Revenue +47.9%, EPS +85.4%; fwd P/E 20.12, PEG 0.44 → undervalued. 45 analysts Strong Buy, mean target $527.88 (34.6% upside). Moat: hyperscale lock-in.

📊 Tape:
• 📈 Weekly/monthly uptrend; 50 EMA > 200 EMA (golden cross); RSI 52.7 neutral; MACD mildly positive; volume falling, seller bias.
• 🎯 Support $370.16 / Resistance $400.79 — R:R poor (0.39); price at 0.5 Fib ($392.48).

🎯 Verdict: Bullish, conviction 7/10. Key level: $400.79 — a break opens $446+; core reason: 0.44 PEG + 34.6% upside + AI moat outweigh weak daily tape. 🫧 Risk: AI capex bubble-deflation could hit $368–370 (-5.6%).

🚀 META +6% to $590 — AI hyperscaler rally pushes it back toward $3T club, but the tape says one thing and the value says another.

📰 What: Blowout cloud earnings + geopolitical thaw sparked a 6% surge Monday (Yahoo).

💰 Value: Fwd P/E 16.9, PEG 0.83 vs 28% revenue growth — undervalued. Analyst target $768 = 30% upside. Moat: massive network effects.

📊 Tape:
• 📉 Daily bearish — below EMA20/50/200, death cross, RSI 47 neutral, MACD negative. Volume tilts buyers.
• 🎯 Support $581.86 (1.4% away) vs resistance $669.31 (13.4% up) — R:R 9.4.

🎯 Verdict: Bullish, conviction 6/10. Key level: $581.86 support must hold. Undervalued on PEG + 30% target upside, but 🫧 earnings contracted 13.4% — AI capex anxiety could unwind this fast.

🚨 MSTR Sells $105M in Bitcoin — Forced Liquidation Signals Strain

📰 Strategy sold 1,638 BTC to fund preferred dividends under a liquidity framework adopted in late June (Yahoo).

💰 Overvalued: Forward P/E 21.3 looks cheap, but PEG 2.85 + negative margins + D/E 14.9 = broken balance sheet. Moat: Weak — no durable edge, just leveraged BTC beta.

📊 Tape:
• 📉 Bearish across daily/weekly/monthly; price $94.86 below EMA20/50/200 (97.5/110.5/167.1), death cross intact. RSI 44.7 neutral, volume falling.
• 🎯 Support $89.95 / Resistance $101.00 — reward:risk only 1.25. Fib wall at $114.56 (0.786).

🎯 Verdict: Bearish, 8/10 conviction. Key level: $89.95 support — a break opens the door to $81.81 swing low. 🫧 Bubble risk: forced sales + beta 3.56 = crash fuel if BTC rolls over.

🚨 TSLA at $322 — every major moving average broken, RSI 36.8, and the market is done waiting for promises.

📰 What: Veteran analyst flags Tesla's "next critical test" — AI/autonomy narrative now needs hard financial proof (Yahoo).

💰 Value: Forward P/E 145x, PEG 4.6, EV/EBITDA 112x — overvalued vs 3% earnings contraction. Moat: strong (vertical integration + FSD lead).

📊 Tape:
• 📉 Daily/weekly/monthly all down; price under EMA20/50/200 (347/374/393), death cross, MACD -4.7, rising volume = sellers.
• 🛡️ Support $297.38 · 🚀 Resistance $413.01 — R:R 3.68:1 to the upside if support holds.

🎯 Verdict: Bearish (7/10) — key level $297.38; overvalued on shrinking earnings + full bearish regime. 🫧 AI-bubble unwind risk real at beta 1.83.
